title: H_1 of the naive cotangent complex of a field over F_p vanishes
statement: Let $K$ be a field of characteristic $p>0$, an $\mathbf F_p$-algebra in the unique way. Then $H_1(L_{K/\mathbf F_p})=0$, where $H_1(L_{K/\mathbf F_p})$ is the first homology of the naive cotangent complex of the canonical presentation $\mathbf F_p[K]\to K$ [def-weil-pbc-smooth-ring-map].

source.place: Algebra, Proposition Tag 0322 (proposition-characterize-separable-field-extensions, line 44475), characteristic p, (1) => (5), applied with k = F_p, which is perfect (Definition Tag 030Y, line 10489: every extension of a perfect field is separable; Lemma Tag 030Z, line 10495: F_p is perfect as x^p = x on F_p); used in More on Algebra, proof of Proposition 07E5 ('H_1(L_{K/F_p}) = 0 as K/F_p is separable'); tags verified in stacks-project/tags/tags

proof.text: A positive characteristic of a field is prime (CharP.char_prime_of_ne_zero), so ZMod p is a perfect field. For each finitely generated intermediate field E, IntermediateField.essFiniteType_iff supplies the essentially-finite-type instance. Mathlib Algebra.FormallySmooth.of_perfectField gives formal smoothness and Algebra.FormallySmooth.subsingleton_h1Cotangent gives vanishing for E.

Apply [lem-weil-pbc-h1-cotangent-finite-subfields] to these vanishings to obtain vanishing for K. This is the finite-support step of the old route, with finite-extension vanishing discharged directly by Mathlib.

mathlib_candidate.how: Mathlib gives FormallySmooth K L, hence Subsingleton (H1Cotangent K L), for L separably generated over K (a separating transcendence family v with L separable algebraic over K(v)) and for L essentially of finite type over a perfect K. An arbitrary field of characteristic p need not be separably generated over F_p (F_p(t^{1/p^infinity}) is perfect, so it is purely inseparable over every F_p(s), s transcendental), and Mathlib has no statement that H1Cotangent or formal smoothness passes to directed unions of subalgebras; agreement of Algebra.H1Cotangent with the node's H_1 (canonical presentation) is by definition (Extension/Cotangent/Basic.lean:561, abbrev over Generators.self, the kernel of the cotangent complex :339). Not a leaf (B8).
